formulae.display_policy: Exact rational tau endpoints and pi-free period/change coefficients are retained. Pi-bearing displayed values use numerical approximate pi and six-significant-digit outward rounding under that display model; they are not certified transcendental bounds or a future evolution theorem.

input_scope: Compact c389 selection and43 bounded original closed RESULT event cases only; no checkpoints, archive payloads, producers, operators, controls or trajectories replayed.
interpretation: These are local angular-rate scales from the selected saved upper-side raw-jet radial-balance branch. Nonzero Omega_dot excludes constant Omega for that event; its instantaneous scale need not imply rapid breakdown. Multiplying the instantaneous derivative by one nominal period is a local dimensionless diagnostic, not an integrated orbit/history. Sheet averaging affects only its admitted normal rule; no exact axisymmetry, reflection or projected phi was assumed here.
